The Farrell-Morhenn office will be [b]closed on Saturday 4 July[/b] for Independence Day. Normal office hours resume on Monday 6 July at 09:00.

Clients with an urgent matter should leave a message on 555-0147, and an attorney will return the call as soon as possible.
